summary: Independent EvidenceGate review requests changes: budget enforcement is incomplete and declared verification boundaries can pass without VerificationService.

criteria.criterion: Only admitted immutable PlanIR can start execution.
criteria.notes: Verified invalid PlanValidationReport and PlanIR digest mismatch are rejected before execution starts.

criteria.criterion: DAG dependencies, concurrency limits, budgets and deadlines are enforced.
criteria.notes: DAG, concurrency, deadline and wall-clock budget are covered, but PlanBudget maxModelCalls, maxToolCalls, maxSpawnedNodes and maxCostUsd are only validated/snapshotted; no runtime usage enforcement path exists in NodeExecutionResult or StaticPlanScheduler.

criteria.criterion: Crash/restart simulation resumes from checkpoint without repeating completed idempotent nodes.
criteria.notes: Focused resume test confirms completed idempotent nodes are not repeated across scheduler restart.

criteria.criterion: Stale lease/fencing token writes are rejected.
criteria.notes: Focused CAS/fencing test confirms stale expected_version and stale fencing_token writes are rejected.

criteria.criterion: Cancellation propagates to active nodes and leaves auditable terminal state.
criteria.notes: Focused cancellation test confirms active and pending NodeRuns become canceled and a handoff ref is left.

criteria.criterion: Task/Goal, PlanExecution and NodeRun each retain distinct authority.
criteria.notes: Projection and reconciler keep AWKP Task, Goal, PlanExecution and NodeRun authority refs distinct.

criteria.criterion: The static vertical slice produces complete Artifact/Evidence/Trace/Handoff records and passes the Goal completion gate.
criteria.notes: The happy-path fixture passes with a verifier, but StaticPlanScheduler with verification_service=None still returns succeeded and EVD-goal, so declared goal/gate verification does not fail closed.
